subject: Post-call: RetailCo model fit & regression concerns
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@retailco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — model fit / regression concerns

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery + the follow-ups we committed to: 

1) Observed issue:
- You called out a regression in NLU/intent classification quality after the recent model update to redwood-7b v2.0 on your production intent route (retailco-intent-prod).
- Examples you shared pointed to increased false positives on the "promo_opt_in" intent and truncated entity extraction in long-form chat responses.

2) Recommended short-term options (to be prioritized by your team):
- Pin route to the previous stable version (redwood-7b v1.2.1) — immediate rollback if regression is blocking production KPI.
- Canary/Rollout: route 10% of traffic to v1.2.1 while keeping v2.0 at 90% to validate correctness vs. latency/cost.
- Temporary routing to Dedicated capacity for the weekday peak window if you want isolation while we investigate.

3) Diagnostics we will run (deliverables):
- Diff report of model outputs on your canonical prompt set (attached: retailco_eval_diffs_20270420.csv).
- Collated failing prompts you provided + additional probes (please send any more edge cases).
- Recommended model alternatives and quantization profiles (quick wins often: redwood-3b-ptq for cost-sensitive routes).

4) Next steps / owners:
- Marissa (me): start regression diff and coordinate rollback playbook with engineering; share EOD report and recommended pining option.
- Rishi: confirm approval of credits / rollback policy for enterprise customers (if we need to issue a temporary credit for impact).
- Stephanie (CS): coordinate post-rollback testing window and CSM communications to RetailCo stakeholders.
- Alex: please prioritize 3–5 failing prompts (attached: retailco_failing_prompts.txt) and confirm whether latency or accuracy is higher priority for this route.

Attachments: retailco_eval_diffs_20270420.csv, retailco_failing_prompts.txt, rollback_playbook_v1.2.1.pdf
Links: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/evals/retailco/20270420 (detailed diffs), https://benchmark.redwood.ai/models/redwood-7b/v2.0/diff-report

I'll follow up with a concrete rollback/canary plan in my next email once engineering confirms the deployment window.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@retailco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Brenda Lawson <brenda.lawson@retailco.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — model fit / regression concerns

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and fast turnaround. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We upgraded to redwood-7b v2.0 last Friday (2027-04-16) and started seeing the increase in false positives on the "promo_opt_in" intent starting Monday morning in our A/B tests.
- Attached are 6 representative failing prompts and the expected vs. actual outputs (see retailco_failing_prompts.txt).
- Latency is important but accuracy is critical here — a wrong promo_opt_in classification yields incorrect downstream offers and directly impacts conversions.

Immediate ask: if rolling back to v1.2.1 is a revert that can be done with low risk, please prioritize it. We can tolerate a short maintenance window outside peak (we're in PST timezone). If a full rollback is risky, the 10% canary + pin strategy sounds good as a fallback.

Also: can you share an estimate for the impact to token-level cost if we pin to v1.2.1 vs keep v2.0? We need to present this to finance.

Appreciate the help —
Alex
Head of ML Products, RetailCo
alex.johnson@retailco.com | +1 (206) 555-0199

On Tue, Apr 20, 2027 at 4:12 PM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (see above)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@retailco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — model fit / regression concerns

Alex —

Thanks for the context and the failing examples — that's really helpful. Quick operational plan from Redwood: 

1) Immediate (next 4 hours):
- Open a support ticket and mark as P1 for regression on retailco-intent-prod. (ticket: RD-SUP-20270421-117)
- Engineering (David) to validate that a rollback to redwood-7b v1.2.1 for the route is safe and estimate the window. If safe, we can schedule rollback tonight between 10pm–11pm PST (outside peak) and pin the route to v1.2.1.

2) Canary fallback (if rollback not advisable):
- Implement 10% traffic split to v1.2.1 for 24 hours, collect metrics (precision/recall on promo_opt_in, latency p50/p95).

3) Cost impact:
- Preliminary estimate: redwood-7b v2.0 uses ~12% more tokens on average due to longer decode and safety add-ons; v1.2.1 should reduce token-level cost by ~8–12% for this workload. I'll confirm a more precise delta after the diff run (EOD deliverable).

4) Remediation & longer term:
- If regression is tied to a behavioral shift in v2.0, we'll provide pinned model recommendation (v1.2.1) plus a test harness for your prompt set so you can run a nightly QA against any new model before flip.

Action items:
- Alex: confirm you want us to proceed with rollback tonight (10–11pm PST) OR start the 10% canary.
- David: can you confirm rollback safety and ETA?
- Rishi: can you confirm credit/comp approval in case RetailCo requests a goodwill credit for impacted traffic?

I'll attach the initial diff CSV and the rollback playbook; David will confirm the deployment steps shortly.

Thanks —
Marissa

Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — model fit / regression concerns

Team —

I reviewed the notes and the initial diffs. Given RetailCo's revenue sensitivity on this route, I approve the following: 

1) Approve rollback to redwood-7b v1.2.1 tonight 10:00–11:00pm PST. Please keep the rollback window as short as possible and alert on any errors.
2) If the rollback is applied, Redwood will issue a one-time usage credit for impacted traffic — finance/ops, please prepare the credit memo under deal RD-4871.
3) David: coordinate the rollback playbook and validate DB/route compatibility. If you see any blocking issue, pivot to the 10% canary plan and notify me immediately.

Alex — we will confirm via this thread when rollback is scheduled and complete. Stephanie, please prepare a short customer-facing note for Alex's stakeholders with expected test/validation steps post-rollback.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
